minor.issue: Endpoint name mentioned in request does not exist; actual route is POST /api/payroll/periods/{id}/calculate. Test was updated to use the real route. No functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: _compute_isr correctly accumulates monthly gross from sister quincena, falling back to current×2 only when sister entry is missing (safe default for first-quincena seed). DGII-compliant.

recompute_sister_quincena_isr respects manual overrides (entry-level isr_manual_override_entry, profile-level isr_manual_override, isr_discount=false) and skips already paid/approved sister periods — good.
dgii_monthly._consolidate_month uses simple float sum; for DGII reports this is acceptable but consider Decimal/quantize for currency rounding consistency in a future iteration.
DGII validation tolerance of RD$0.50 correctly accounts for the 50-peso step rounding in the published table.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 flows: month selector, summary card, badges, validation modal, IR-3 download, drill-down, ISR policy selector)
